title: SEASON ZERO M1: LIFETIME EARNINGS AND THE 30 RANKS
why: his rulings of 11-01 (season zero m1): lifetime earnings count every dollar earned (47); 30 named ranks, scrounger, cutpurse, sacker, reaver, marauder, warlord, i to v (48 to 50); a reward at every rank (51); shown at the Mainframe and on the account card, never over the head in a raid, never gating anything (52, 53); a brand new account starts with 1,000 dollars (40). Curve from his flight recorder of 11-01: extracted hauls average about 41,000 dollars and about 1 run in 3 gets out (about 12,500 dollars a raid); early hauls on a starter kit 5,000 to 15,000
now: RANKS: scrounger i at 0, scrounger ii at 20,000 (about two good early raids), each step about 6 percent more than the last (20,000 then 21,000, 23,000 ... 99,000, 107,000), warlord v at 1,500,000 (about 120 raids, six weeks at about 20 raids a week). Rewards alternate cash (2,500 rising to 25,000 at warlord v, 121,000 in all) and kits of existing items (bandages, frags, medkits, plates, stims, smokes, decoys, data cores); a reward is not earnings. A rank is paid once when reached (P.rankPaid) with one floor line (rank up: sacker ii and its reward); a buy back or spending never lowers the rank. An old save is stamped once (P.mig1r): every rank its lifetime earnings reach is marked paid without paying. The Mainframe has a strip on every tab (rank, lifetime earnings, next rank, its reward, a bar); the stats page has a lifetime earnings card with the rank. A new profile starts with 1,000 dollars (was 900)
